headline: Approved process for initial self-evaluation using CABE instrument; student achievement data was presented.
summary: The committee heard a presentation on student achievement data. It also discussed, and then approved 2-0, the process for an initial self-evaluation using the CABE evaluation instrument.
decisions: Approved the process for completing an initial self-evaluation using the CABE evaluation instrument, 2-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of the process for completing an initial self-evaluation of the Board of Education using the evaluation instrument provided by CABE. (Approved: 2-0, Kaplan, Ciccarini)
